### AddPseudoTwoAddrDeps() {#a883ff468e6ea584087e66416d02a5e48}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">
<td class="doxyMemberLabelsLeft">

<span class="doxyMemberLabels">
<span class="doxyMemberLabel protected">protected</span>
</span>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>AddPseudoTwoAddrDeps - If two nodes share an operand and one of them uses it as a def&amp;use operand.</p>


<p>Add a pseudo control edge from it to the other node (if it won't create a cycle) so the two-address one will be scheduled first (lower in the schedule). If both nodes are two-address, favor the one that has a CopyToReg use (more likely to be a loop induction update). If both are two-address, but one is commutable while the other is not commutable, favor the one that's not commutable.</p>

### PrescheduleNodesWithMultipleUses() {#a6df9e18cc58cb146ccfa7c7d47b6b9ca}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">
<td class="doxyMemberLabelsLeft">
<table class="doxyMemberName">
<tr>
<td class="doxyMemberName">void RegReductionPQBase::PrescheduleNodesWithMultipleUses ()</td>
</tr>
</table>
</td>
<td class="doxyMemberLabelsRight">
<span class="doxyMemberLabels">
<span class="doxyMemberLabel protected">protected</span>
</span>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>PrescheduleNodesWithMultipleUses - Nodes with multiple uses are not handled well by the general register pressure reduction heuristics.</p>


<p>When presented with code like this:</p>



<pre><code> N
</code></pre>


<p>/ | / | U store | ...</p>


<p>the heuristics tend to push the store up, but since the operand of the store has another use (U), this would increase the length of that other use (the U-&gt;N edge).</p>


<p>This function transforms code like the above to route U's dependence through the store when possible, like this:</p>



<pre><code> N
 ||
 ||
store
  |
  U
  |
 ...
</code></pre>


<p>This results in the store being scheduled immediately after N, which shortens the U-&gt;N live range, reducing register pressure.</p>


<p>Definition at line 1842 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/codegen/lib/codegen/selectiondag/scheduledagrrlist-cpp">ScheduleDAGRRList.cpp</a>.</p>
